story_text: As a guest, I want to filter bookings by status so that I can see only pending, confirmed, or cancelled reservations.

positive.title: Filter bookings by status 'pending'
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Add pending as parametr value
4. Click submit
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with pending status are shown

positive.title: Filter bookings by status 'confirmed'
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Add confirmed as parametr value
4. Click submit
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with confirmed status are shown

positive.title: Filter bookings by status 'cancelled'
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Add cancelled as parametr value
4. Click submit
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with cancelled status are shown

positive.title: Filter bookings with a missing status parameter
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Leave the value empty
4. Click submit

negative.title: Filter bookings by an invalid status value returns an error
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Add 'waiting' or any other status as parametr value
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: An error stating only 3 statuses are available

edge.title: Filter bookings by status with mixed case
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Add pending as parametr value but in mixed case writing
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error stating only 3 statuses are available

edge.title: Filter bookings by a valid status when no bookings match
steps: 1. Navigate to the get bookings endpoint
2. Add the status as parameter key
3. Add pending as parametr value
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An Empty list to be displayed
